sources.name: Joseph Bourke memorial · university courtyard photograph and sculpture dimensions
sources.notes: Full university photograph inspected: irregular shallow pool, pale sandstone-like coping, rough grey boulders, taller standing stone bearing a small bronze portrait and projecting shallow spill dish. University gives Tom Bass, 1967, commissioned 1966; bronze portrait alone measures 30 × 24 × 4 cm. The old generic pipe sculpture is replaced. Fountain location retains the previous photo-fitted courtyard position; stone dimensions, plan, orientation, water levels and present operation remain estimates.

sources.name: Tom Bass · Joseph Bourke bronze portrait detail
sources.notes: Full university detail photograph inspected: irregular vertical bronze relief with swept hair, three-quarter face, ear, collar and small initials at lower left. A small original procedural relief study follows its general structure within the reported 30 × 24 × 4 cm envelope; precise likeness, casting detail and patina are not reproduced. Source pixels are not copied.

sources.name: Morven Brown lawn · reverse fountain photograph
sources.notes: Full labelled 480 × 640 photo inspected. Reverse view clarifies the rough low edging stones, dark shallow basin, larger rear standing stone, spill dish and mature jacaranda beside the cafe canopy. Capture date unverified; pool profile, stone positions and levels remain photo-fitted, not surveyed.

sources.name: Morven Brown · July 2015 fountain and cafe context
sources.notes: Official Google Street View re-inspected natively at -33.9166694, 151.2329002, heading 80°, capture July 2015. Fountain lies between lawn and curved cafe canopy with standing stone behind the pool. It corroborates the existing photo-fitted court location and rough orientation, not exact dimensions or present water operation. No panorama pixels are redistributed.
